stem: Which statement explains why one organism is better adapted to the removal of the tall trees?

options.label: A
options.text: The fungi are better adapted because they have spores that grow better in the dark.

options.label: B
options.text: The ferns are better adapted because they have strong root systems.

options.label: C
options.text: The fungi are better adapted because they can get energy from decaying trees.

options.label: D
options.text: The ferns are better adapted because they get energy from the sun.
